data.one_liner: A customizable fullscreen image viewer with zoom and drag-to-dismiss features.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable fullscreen viewer for images with pinch-to-zoom and swipe-down-to-dismiss features. It can be opened imperative-style using static methods or wrapped using helper widgets.
use_when: You need to display a single image in a fullscreen view with zoom capabilities
You want users to be able to swipe down or drag to dismiss an image view
avoid_when: You need a complex multi-image gallery with pre-caching and advanced carousel features
strengths: Includes pinch-to-zoom out of the box
Cross-platform support across mobile, desktop, and web
weaknesses: Limited feature set compared to advanced gallery viewers like photo_view
Not documented for complex multi-image paging or caching configuration

alternatives.name: photo_view
alternatives.why_pick_it: More mature and full-featured image zooming and pan management library.

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you primarily need caching and placeholder handling for network images.
